[/size][/b][url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/unofficial-mod-updates.2096/]Content Patcher Requests[/url]﻿
^ This is the correct places to request things

Not sure what is in JsonAssets scope? Take a gander at the [url=https://github.com/spacechase0/JsonAssets/blob/master/README.md]official documentation[/url]﻿.

Any posts after this edit requesting a conversion will be deleted

[b]Edit 9/6/2021[/b]: Feels like once a year I check on this page. These mods are still for JA at the time of writing this. I'll be converting them over to DGA as time goes on. While I have retired, if you feel that you don't want to maintain your mod, please message Pathoschild and I can convert it and put it up here for you.

Edit 9/5/2020: All of the mods posted are here are only uploaded here with permission, as such the `with permission` notation has been removed. Due to the maintainership of Yoseiri's mods this is now JA & Friends so may include Content Patcher, GetGlam, BFAV, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/syytYWb.png[/img]﻿

Each download is separate, pick accordingly.
